scope: All Savings stablecoin entries without _intrinsicOracles before this audit; existing token identities, categories and configured sources were preserved. This is not proof that an unverified token has no oracle.
method: Inspect issuer/provider deployment registries and exact chain/token identities. Prefer identifiable Chainlink/RedStone fundamental NAV or exchange-rate feeds, not generic USD pegs or reserves.
Verify current and month-old observations and units using live RPC. Use canonical share conversions when no preferable verified provider NAV source is attributable.
Do not combine observations from different sources, reinterpret distributions/rebases as price growth, accept stale stored feeds, or substitute same-symbol assets.
Keep timestamp-free computed NAV limited to explicitly configured metadata and exact canonical token() identity at both pinned archive blocks.
